Checks visible price/currency/date, price-to-store destination pairing, sticky purchase meaning, language roundtrip, cards/representatives/hero, no overflow, and18 accessibility scans. Does not use the UI price helper to generate the expected figures, open merchant checkouts, claim physical shelf prices, or perform currency conversion.
